messages:
olivia: quick RN + rollout sketch for v2.3.3 (quant stability + perf). need copycheck + pin owner. plan below.

olivia: RN draft:
• What: v2.3.3-quant-fix — stability fixes to quant kernels, ~15% tail throughput uplift, reduced streaming stalls.
• Fixes: OOM mitigation during KV refill, faster cache priming.
• Note: fallback to v2.3.2 for Dedicated when GPU capacity low.

olivia: rollout plan: canary 2% -> 20% after 10m -> 60% after 40m -> 100% after 90m. rollback gates: error >2.5x baseline for 5m OR p95 latency >600ms for 10m. enable debug logs for canary first 15m.

matt: I can own the model pin and kickoff. proposed model id: model-redwood/v2.3.3-qf, stack: inference-v2.3.

jordan: i'll own the rollback watch and final go/no-go. ping me at promote->20%. i'll wire alerts and heartbeat.

nina: docs copy nit: change "fallback" -> "automatic fallback to v2.3.2 for Dedicated customers when capacity constrained". internal snippet suggestion: "Heads up: v2.3.3 rollout at 11:00 UTC — stability and perf fixes. Ops monitoring."

matt: deploy-bot schedule set for 2025-06-15T11:00:00Z. params below.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @matt. job id: db-1807770000. commands:
```
deploy-bot run db-1807770000 --stage canary --percent 2 --wait 600 --debug-logs true
deploy-bot promote db-1807770000 --percent 20 --wait 2400 --dns-hold 300
deploy-bot promote db-1807770000 --percent 60 --wait 3600
deploy-bot promote db-1807770000 --percent 100
deploy-bot rollback db-1807770000 --reason "rollback gate triggered"
```

jordan: please add --fallback-delay 600 after the 20% promote to avoid oscillation. i'll increase alert sensitivity for first 25m.

matt: ack, adding --fallback-delay 600.

olivia: final checklist: RN updated per nina, model pin set, deploy job scheduled, rollback watch assigned, internal snippet ready for T-10. final go/no-go at 10:45 UTC.

deploy-bot: job db-1807770000 moved to queued state by @matt.
